ON APPEAL FROM THE EAST INDIES. 27

Musadee Mahomed Cazum Sherazee - Appellant.

AND

Meerza Ally Mahomed Shoostry - Respondent.

On appeal from the Supreme Court at Bombay.

* Present: Members of the Judicial Committee.

4th Dec. 1854.

This was an appeal from an order made in a cause.

The Order in Council reversed the decree.

ON APPEAL FROM THE EAST INDIES. 133

134 CASES IN THE PRIVY COUNCIL

Nusserwanjee Pestonjee - Appellant.

AND

Meer Mynoodeen Khan Bahadoor - Respondent.

On appeal from the Sudder Dewanny Adawlut at Bombay.

* Present: The Right Hon. T. Pemberton Leigh.

19th June, 1855.

This appeal raised the question of an award.

Their Lordships advised that the appeal be dismissed.
